senses.gloss:
जृम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. gaping, yawning;
bursting open; blossoming, swelling, blowing, being
puffed up; expansion, stretching, expanding; (अस्),
m. a particular animal.
—जृम्भा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
yawning, gaping.

जृम्भक, अस्, m. a yawner, a sort of demon or
spirit; N. of certain magical formularies for exorcising
the evil spirits supposed to possess weapons; (इका),
f. gaping, yawning; (अम्), n. swelling.

जृम्भमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, gaping, yawning;
opening, blossoming, blowing.

जृम्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ, yawning, gaping; expanding,
blossoming; (इणी), f. the plant Mimosa Octandra,
= एलापर्णी.
